name: Placing an order
case: one order: one row in ordering.orders, created as Submitted (Order.cs:57; OrderRepository.cs:17)
starts_at: the customer begins checkout with a non-empty basket on /checkout (Checkout.razor:1, 6)
ends_at: proposed: the order is delivered to the customer; the code's last state is Shipped (OrderStatus.cs:12), set by an administrator, and nothing records delivery
expectation_of: the customer placing the order, who is sent to their orders page (Checkout.razor:115)
promise: none stated; proposed: the order is delivered by the date promised at checkout (SCOR Perfect Order Fulfillment)
case_identifier: the order id from GracePeriodConfirmed on; before it the request id and the user id (about.csv case_identifier)

name: Filling a basket
case: one customer's basket: the basket store holds one per signed-in user, keyed by the user id (RedisBasketRepository.cs:16). It has no id of its own: each line gets a throwaway Guid (BasketState.cs:138)
starts_at: proposed: the signed-in customer begins looking for something to buy, on the catalogue page (Catalog.razor:196-203) or in the assistant (Chatbot.razor:103-107). The stored basket first exists at the first add (RedisBasketRepository.cs:37); until then the basket service answers an empty basket (Basket.API Grpc/BasketService.cs:26-33)
ends_at: the customer takes the basket to checkout (CartPage.razor:97), where Placing an order starts (Checkout.razor:1); or leaves it, which nothing records: the basket is written with no expiry (RedisBasketRepository.cs:37)
expectation_of: the signed-in customer filling the basket
promise: none stated; proposed: what the customer adds stays in the basket, priced at the catalogue's current price, until they check out or remove it
case_identifier: the user id, taken from the caller's identity (Basket.API Grpc/BasketService.cs:38; RedisBasketRepository.cs:16)
hands_to: F1 at checkout: the user id is the only key both flows share (BasketState.cs:85; OrderStartedIntegrationEvent.cs:8)
agent_systems: A0, the shopping assistant (agent-system.csv), joins at steps 21, 23 and 27
